context_types.label: Job failure
context_types.description: A scheduled batch job failed or ended not-OK — the evidence describes the failure, its investigation, or its resolution.

context_types.label: Missed data load
context_types.description: An expected data load did not happen or did not complete in its window — downstream consumers saw stale or absent data.

context_types.label: Missed file
context_types.description: An expected inbound or outbound file did not arrive, was late, or was empty — file-watcher / transfer-level, before any load ran.

context_types.label: Data issue
context_types.description: The pipeline ran but the data is wrong — bad values, duplicates, schema surprises, reconciliation breaks.
